Name: Save Anywhere
Author: Aredjay
Description:
[center][size=5]Install[/size][/center]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]How To Use[/size]
Press K to save anywhere. Edit the config.json file in a text editor to change the key (it will appear once you run the game), if you have GMCM use it instead.

[size=4]Created by Aredjay, RealSweetPanda, and Omegasis[/size]

[size=5]Mod Authors:[/size]
Save anywhere has an official API with SMAPI! If you are a mod author you can use this to hopefully solve some of the compatibility issues!
The source code for that is [url=https://github.com/RealSweetPanda/SaveAnywhereRedux/blob/main/Framework/SaveAnywhereAPI.cs]here[/url]﻿.
[size=5]Notes[/size]
The mod should now work with map extension mods, modded characters, modded items, etc in the newest update. If it doesn't, report it and we can fix it. 

As much as we want to make the mod stable, this mod might crash and cause issues. just be aware and if it occurs just report it and we will fix it!

Downloads.Description: This version should be a fix for most of the previous issues making the mod unusable. Check the changelog for more info and ensure to use the Save Backup mod at all times while using this mod!
